title: WoW Expansions Kept Breaking the PC Sales Record
hook: Wrath of the Lich King sold 2.8 million copies in one day back in 2008, and Blizzard kept beating its own record until Shadowlands hit 3.7 million in 2020. Which expansion did you buy on launch day?
sources: https://investor.activision.com/node/17931 (Activision press release, Nov 20 2008: Wrath 2.8M in 24 hours, fastest-selling PC game; Burning Crusade nearly 2.4M)
https://investor.activision.com/node/18801 (Activision press release, Dec 13 2010: Cataclysm more than 3.3M in first 24 hours)
https://investor.activisionblizzard.com/node/33796 (Activision Blizzard press release, Dec 8 2020: Shadowlands 3.7M first full day, fastest-selling PC game of all time industry-wide)
https://gamebanshee.com/kwyxp (Blizzard press release: WoW launches Nov 23 2004)
script: Did you know a World of Warcraft expansion was, for a time, the fastest selling PC game ever made? Blizzard set that record more than once. Wrath of the Lich King launched for World of Warcraft in November of two thousand eight. It sold more than two point eight million copies in its very first day on sale. Blizzard called it the fastest selling PC game of all time. The previous record belonged to its own Burning Crusade, at nearly two point four million copies. Two years later, Cataclysm broke the record again. It moved more than three point three million copies in a single day, beating the Lich King's mark. Blizzard's own Diablo Three then grabbed the record away in two thousand twelve, selling three and a half million copies on its first day of release. Then in two thousand twenty, the Shadowlands expansion took the title back for World of Warcraft. Blizzard reported more than three point seven million units sold on its first full day. By Blizzard's own count, that made it the fastest selling PC game ever at the time. A game that first launched back in two thousand four was still breaking launch records sixteen whole years later. WoW grabbed it again and again across more than a decade. Which expansion did you line up for on launch day? Follow for more gaming history.
